messages:
maya: quick sync from the design huddle. attaching compact drilldown mocks in Figma. primary items: collapsed correlation-id visibility, consistent export verbs, screen-reader announcements, and focus order on compact rows. any immediate nits?

igor: proposal: when drilldown is collapsed show a small corr-id pill left of the actions. pill should truncate (1234...abcd) with hover to expand and a copy affordance. keyboard focus must land on the pill before reaching secondary actions.

sam: agree. placement question: do we render the one-line error summary above the pill or below? product wants summary above so the pill feels contextual.

maya: summary above works. during collapsed state reserve the right-side for inline actions: copy, save, open-full. keeps reading flow left-to-right.

sara: accessibility reminders: copy button needs an aria-live polite announcement like 'Correlation ID copied to clipboard'. also ensure visible focus ring on pill and separate keyboard target for the copy action.

lin: on wording: our pattern currently uses 'Download trace' everywhere. partners suggested 'Save snapshot' for drilldowns (static export) to avoid confusion. i think 'Save snapshot' for drilldowns and keep 'Download trace' on the full trace page.

igor: fine with 'Save snapshot' for drilldown. add a tooltip 'Includes headers + stacktrace' for clarity. shorter primary label in compact mode is helpful.

maya: proposed copy for flows: button label: 'Save snapshot' visual toast: 'Snapshot saved — open in Trace Viewer' sr text (aria-live polite): 'Snapshot saved. Link to open trace available.'

sara: tweak: avoid instructive verbs like 'Press Enter' for SRs unless that's the explicit next action. neutral SR text is better. also failures should use role=alert: 'Snapshot failed to save' and focus the toaster for screen-reader visibility.

igor: sign-off condition: pill must be tabbable and have aria-label='Correlation ID: 1234... (copy)'.

sam: sign-off. minor enhancement: pill shows a subtle warning icon (⚠️) when downstream latency >500ms so users can triage at-a-glance.

maya: will add a latency state and update comps. design-bot: uploaded updated Figma -> https://www.figma.com/file/XXXXX/compact-drilldown-correl-ux

sara: i'll draft acceptance checks for accessibility in the PR: focus order, live region copy, keyboard-only copy flow, toaster roles.

maya: thanks — i'll update mocks, add copy snippets in the PR, and tag for a final review before shipping. :thumbsup:
